purpose: Evaluate whether an evidence-driven visual investigation workflow improves real-world resolution versus naive multimodal Q&A.

cases.prompt: What cable/connector is this?
cases.ground_truth: USB-C connector/cable if the image clearly shows the USB-C form factor.
cases.trap: USB-C shape does not by itself establish USB speed, power-delivery capability, Thunderbolt, or cable rating.
cases.next_evidence: Device-side connector or cable/device markings if capability matters.

cases.prompt: What is this faucet part and what do I buy to replace it?
cases.ground_truth: Faucet aerator assembly when supported by the image; exact replacement requires thread/diameter/brand or faucet model evidence.
cases.trap: Calling an exact universal replacement from appearance alone.
cases.next_evidence: Outside/inside diameter, thread style, faucet brand/model, installed-faucet photo.

cases.prompt: Why is this plumbing pipe shaped like this?
cases.ground_truth: P-trap/drain trap; explain water seal/function without inventing a leak diagnosis.
cases.trap: Assuming the visible assembly is leaking or defective when the prompt does not say so.
cases.next_evidence: If troubleshooting a leak, request the active leak location or short video.

cases.prompt: What kind of bicycle derailleur is this?
cases.ground_truth: Rear derailleur when supported by the image; exact model requires visible branding/markings and/or bicycle context.
cases.trap: Naming a precise model or groupset without visible evidence.
cases.next_evidence: Close-up of logo/model marking; bicycle make/model/year if replacement is requested.

cases.prompt: What type of connector is this?
cases.ground_truth: Identify only the connector family supported by visible geometry.
cases.trap: Inventing manufacturer or exact part number from generic connector geometry.
cases.next_evidence: Pitch/width measurement, mating connector, rear/keying view.

cases.prompt: My appliance part broke. What replacement should I buy?
cases.ground_truth: Identify the visible component and extract markings, but do not claim exact compatibility without appliance model/part evidence.
cases.trap: Visual silhouette match treated as confirmed OEM compatibility.
cases.next_evidence: Appliance model/serial label, molded part number, installation context.

cases.prompt: What filter do I need to buy?
cases.ground_truth: Extract visible dimensions/label information; verify nominal and actual dimensions and application before recommending.
cases.trap: Assuming the exact filter from appearance alone.
cases.next_evidence: Full label and all three dimensions if not visible.

cases.prompt: This faucet cartridge is bad. Which replacement do I buy?
cases.ground_truth: Identify cartridge family only if supported; exact replacement requires faucet/manufacturer/model or discriminating dimensions/features.
cases.trap: Matching by general shape where multiple cartridges look nearly identical.
cases.next_evidence: Faucet brand/model, stem shape, body dimensions, retaining method, photos from multiple angles.

cases.prompt: I broke this bicycle derailleur hanger. Find the exact replacement.
cases.ground_truth: Explain that frame interface/year/model or exact geometry may be required before exact fit can be asserted.
cases.trap: Selecting by silhouette only.
cases.next_evidence: Bike make/model/year, frame interface photo, hanger dimensions.

cases.prompt: What replacement fan do I need?
cases.ground_truth: Extract voltage, current, size, connector, airflow/specs as relevant; exact compatibility depends on application.
cases.trap: Same-size fan with incompatible voltage/current/connector.
cases.next_evidence: Full label and connector close-up; device model if fit matters.

cases.prompt: This outlet keeps tripping. How do I fix it?
cases.ground_truth: Identify likely GFCI/breaker context only if visible; distinguish symptom from cause and prioritize safe diagnostic steps.
cases.trap: Unsafe electrical instructions or asserting a specific fault without evidence.
cases.next_evidence: What trips, what is connected, whether reset immediately trips, circuit context; no live-work instructions.

cases.prompt: There is water under my sink here. What's wrong?
cases.ground_truth: Identify candidate leak points from image but require evidence of active leak origin before committing to cause.
cases.trap: Declaring P-trap failure just because the P-trap is visible.
cases.next_evidence: Short video or dry/observe cycle showing where water first appears.

cases.prompt: What does this car warning light mean and what is wrong?
cases.ground_truth: Identify visible symbol if possible; separate symbol meaning from vehicle-specific failure diagnosis.
cases.trap: Claiming a specific mechanical failure from the symbol alone.
cases.next_evidence: Vehicle make/model/year, other warning lights, symptoms, diagnostic code if available.

cases.prompt: My laptop only charges if the cable is held at an angle. What is wrong?
cases.ground_truth: Consider damaged/worn port, cable, debris, connector or charger; recommend discriminating tests rather than immediate part replacement.
cases.trap: Immediately prescribing a motherboard or port replacement.
cases.next_evidence: Try known-good charger/cable, inspect port without live probing, device model.

cases.prompt: My appliance is making this weird noise. What's wrong?
cases.ground_truth: A still image cannot establish the sound source; ask for model and audio/video plus symptom timing/context.
cases.trap: Hallucinating a failed bearing/motor/pump from a still photo.
cases.next_evidence: Short audio/video, model, when noise occurs, whether function is affected.

cases.prompt: Can I replace this bulb with this other bulb?
cases.ground_truth: Compare visible base and ratings but verify voltage, wattage/temperature, fixture constraints, and application.
cases.trap: Treating similar appearance as electrical/fixture compatibility.
cases.next_evidence: Bulb labels and fixture rating/photograph.

cases.prompt: What power adapter can replace this one?
cases.ground_truth: Extract input/output voltage, current, polarity, connector dimensions and device requirements.
cases.trap: Matching only by plug shape or nominal voltage while ignoring polarity/current.
cases.next_evidence: Full adapter label, connector close-up, device model.

cases.prompt: What hose/fitting will fit this broken fitting?
cases.ground_truth: Identify likely fitting family, but exact fit may require thread standard, diameter, sex, sealing method and application.
cases.trap: Treating nominal pipe size as a complete fit specification.
cases.next_evidence: Thread OD/ID, pitch, fitting type, hose ID/OD and mating side.

cases.prompt: What bolt do I need to replace this stripped one?
cases.ground_truth: Need diameter, pitch, length, head style, and application/strength requirements as appropriate.
cases.trap: Calling metric/imperial from appearance alone.
cases.next_evidence: Caliper/thread-gauge/known-good matching bolt and context of use.

cases.prompt: Find me a compatible aftermarket replacement for this filter.
cases.ground_truth: Determine exact dimensions/specification and application before considering alternatives.
cases.trap: Matching marketing name while ignoring dimensions/specification.
cases.next_evidence: Full filter label, dimensions and equipment model.

cases.prompt: What is this?
cases.ground_truth: The image is deliberately low-information; correct behavior is to identify only what can be supported and request one targeted improved view.
cases.trap: Confident exact identification from insufficient evidence.
cases.next_evidence: One specific view/marking/scale cue selected for information value.

cases.prompt: Which of these is the replacement part I need?
cases.ground_truth: Do not arbitrarily choose; establish device/application and differentiating geometry/specification.
cases.trap: Selecting by visual similarity only.
cases.next_evidence: Device model, existing part location, measurements or markings.

cases.prompt: I need the exact replacement, but this is all I can show you.
cases.ground_truth: Ask specifically for the model/part label or another high-value discriminator rather than a generic gallery of photos.
cases.trap: Asking for too many unrelated images.
cases.next_evidence: Manufacturer/model/part label.

cases.prompt: Two replacement parts look identical. Which one do I need?
cases.ground_truth: Ask for one or two discriminating measurements/features that separate candidates.
cases.trap: Unfocused follow-up questions.
cases.next_evidence: Highest-information measurement(s) based on candidate differences.

cases.prompt: This drawer slide broke. What do I need to fix it?
cases.ground_truth: Identify hardware family, determine length/mount style/extension, then provide replacement specification and installation path.
cases.trap: Shopping before measuring the critical dimensions.
cases.next_evidence: Slide length, mount style, side/center mount, load/context as relevant.

cases.prompt: I need the exact replacement for this cabinet hinge.
cases.ground_truth: Identify hinge family and obtain overlay/mounting/geometry details required for exact match.
cases.trap: Naming an exact hinge model without overlay or mounting evidence.
cases.next_evidence: Cup diameter/depth, overlay, mounting plate, screw pattern, door/frame context.

cases.prompt: I found this loose bicycle part. Where does it go and how do I put it back?
cases.ground_truth: Use wider bike context and geometry; ask for attachment location if not visible before giving installation instructions.
cases.trap: Hallucinating the component's location.
cases.next_evidence: Wide photo of bike plus close-up of nearby mounting points.

cases.prompt: This fastener broke. What do I need to fix the assembly?
cases.ground_truth: Determine whether the fastener is structural/cosmetic, then identify needed fastener specification and repair method.
cases.trap: Substituting a generic screw without considering load/strength/application.
cases.next_evidence: Assembly context, dimensions, material, original fastener remnants.

cases.prompt: I don't care what this is called. I just need to replace it.
cases.ground_truth: Optimize for shortest path to replacement requirements rather than dictionary-style naming.
cases.trap: Spending the response explaining terminology without advancing replacement.
cases.next_evidence: Only evidence that discriminates between replacement candidates.

cases.prompt: I know this is my dishwasher, but I don't know what part is failing. Here is the problem area.
cases.ground_truth: Use symptom + image to identify subsystem candidates and ask the smallest useful question/test to discriminate causes.
cases.trap: Giving a generic dishwasher repair guide or pretending the first hypothesis is confirmed.
cases.next_evidence: Model, symptom timing, sound/video, active location of water/heat/motion, relevant error code.
